english.text: Then to Anchises, as he bids us spread / the sails, with reverence speaks Apollo's seer, / "Far-famed Anchises, honoured with the bed / of haughty Venus, Heaven's peculiar care, / Twice saved from Troy! behold Ausonia there, / steer towards her coasts, yet skirt them; far away / that region lies, which Phoebus doth prepare. / Blest in thy son's devotion, take thy way. / Why should more words of mine the rising South delay?"

english.text: And when thy son shall ask thee to morrow, saying: What is this? thou shalt answer him: With a strong hand did the Lord bring us forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage. For when Pharaoh was hardened, and would not let us go, the Lord slew every firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of man to the firstborn of beasts: therefore I sacrifice to the Lord all that openeth the womb of the male sex, and all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.

text: 當你個仔聽日問你，話：呢個係乜嘢嚟嘅？你要回答佢：主用有力嘅手，將我哋從埃及地，由奴役之家帶出嚟。因為當法老硬化，唔肯放我哋走嘅時候，耶和華就殺死埃及地嘅每一個長子，由人嘅長子到獸嘅長子：所以我將所有打開男性子宮嘅，同埋我救贖嘅所有長子，都獻給主。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: One of my favourite things about India is the visionary city of Auroville, created in the 1960s. I wish that China and other countries would aspire to create more visionary cities. I am aware of the Paris-copycat city of Tiāndūchéng in China, complete with the replica of the Eiffel Tower. Fantastic! With 3D printing and AI, city builders around this world will be able to produce more marvellous cities in the future. Imagine that builders will more cheaply opt for Art Nouveau-style architecture and, of course, Metamodernist work. (Art Nouveau is one of my favourite movements.)

jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 jan3 dou6 ge3 kei4 zung1 jat1 joeng6 je5 zau6 hai6 hai2 1960 nin4 doi6 cong3 gin3 ge3 jau5 jyun5 gin3 ge3 sing4 si5 ou3 lo4 wai4 ji5。 ngo5 hei1 mong6 zung1 gwok3 tung4 kei4 taa1 gwok3 gaa1 dou1 hei1 mong6 cong3 zou6 gang3 do1 jau5 jyun5 gin3 ge3 sing4 si5。 ngo5 zi1 dou3 zung1 gwok3 ge3 baa1 lai4 caau1 zaap6 sing4 si5 tin1 tung4 sing4，zung6 jau5 aai1 fei2 ji5 tit3 taap3 ge3 fuk1 zai3 ban2。zing1 coi2！jau5 zo2 3D daa2 jan3 tung4 jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4，ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 gok3 dei6 ge3 sing4 si5 gin3 zou6 ze2 zoeng1 wui5 nang4 gau3 hai2 mei6 loi4 gin3 zou6 ceot1 gang3 do1 kei4 miu6 ge3 sing4 si5。soeng2 zoeng6 jat1 haa5，gin3 zou6 ze2 wui5 gang3 pin4 ji2 gam2 syun2 zaak6 san1 ngai6 seot6 fung1 gaak3 ge3 gin3 zuk1，dong1 jin4 zung6 jau5 jyun4 jin6 doi6 zyu2 ji6 ge3 zok3 ban2（san1 ngai6 seot6 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 wan6 dung6 zi1 jat1。）
text: 我最鍾意印度嘅其中一樣嘢就係喺1960年代創建嘅有遠見嘅城市奧羅維爾。 我希望中國同其他國家都希望創造更多有遠見嘅城市。 我知道中國嘅巴黎抄襲城市天同城，仲有埃菲爾鐵塔嘅複製品。精彩！有咗3D打印同人工智能，呢個世界各地嘅城市建造者將會能夠喺未來建造出更多奇妙嘅城市。想像一下，建造者會更便宜噉選擇新藝術風格嘅建築，當然仲有元現代主義嘅作品（新藝術係我最鍾意嘅運動之一。）
